extraction_notes: Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 contain usable vector plots. Forward and reverse curve points were directly digitized from the plotted curves; no intermediate points were synthesized. Plot current values were converted from the displayed mA or uA axes to A, and plot capacitance values were converted from pF to F.

Fig. 1 shows typical instantaneous forward characteristics at Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC. Fig. 2 shows typical reverse-current magnitude at Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC. The reverse-current curves are represented as positive magnitudes because the graph plots reverse current magnitude.
Fig. 3 shows typical junction capacitance between terminals at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz. The tabulated typical capacitance is 50 pF at VR = 4 V and f = 1.0 MHz.

Absolute maximum ratings from p. 1 at Ta = 25 degC are VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 0.35 A, IFSM = 1.5 A for an 8.3 ms half-sine wave, PD = 200 mW, and Tj = 125 degC. Storage temperature is -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJA is 660 degC/W.
The 40 V VRRM and VDC ratings are operating limits, not published breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current data; breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are therefore null.
